reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Moisture Sun Cream 60ml (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: I loved the whole collection to begin with; this was the last product I needed to try and I wish I did sooner. The product is very light to the skin but packs a punch in hydration and protection
reviews.zh: 我本來就鍾意成個系列；呢個係我最後一款需要試嘅產品，真係早知就早啲試。產品上皮膚感覺好輕，但保濕同防護都落足料。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Moisture Sun Cream 60ml (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: Just repurchased it. This is the best sun cream I ever purchased. No irritation and light as well.
reviews.zh: 已經回購。呢個係我買過最好用嘅防曬。唔刺激，而且都好輕。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Moisture Sun Cream 60ml (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: This sunscreen does not burn my skin the way American sunscreens do! It’s also very moisturizing!
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬唔會好似美國嗰啲防曬咁燒我塊皮膚！而且都好保濕！

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Moisture Sun Cream 60ml (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: Works great doesn't leave a white cast and doesn't sting eyes. I have dry combo skin and it doesn't break me out or make my skin feel oily.
reviews.zh: 效果好好，唔會泛白，亦都唔會拮眼。我係乾性混合肌，用完都唔會爆瘡亦都唔會覺得油笠。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Moisture Sun Cream 60ml (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: Lightweight and refreshing sunscreen that absorbs quickly with no white cast. Provides good hydration without feeling sticky and works well under makeup. Comfortable for daily use.
reviews.zh: 質地輕盈清爽嘅防曬，吸收得好快，唔會泛白。保濕效果好但唔會黏笠，搽底妝都好夾。日常用好舒服。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Moisture Sun Cream 60ml (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: Mình mua lần đầu tiên chưa xài đc bao nhiêu nên chưa cảm nhận đc chất lượng nếu xài Okee lần sau sẽ mua tiếp
reviews.zh: 我第一次買，仲未用過好多，所以暫時感受唔到質素，如果用過 ok 嘅話下次會再買。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Moisture Sun Cream 60ml (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: セットでついてきました。まだ使ったことありませんがトリデンにダメな商品ない気がします。期待大
reviews.zh: 跟住套裝一齊送嘅。仲未用過，但感覺 Toriden 冇差嘅產品。非常期待。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Moisture Sun Cream 60ml (RENEWAL)
reviews.text: The sunscreen feels more like a light moisturizer than SPF, which I love. It sinks in super fast, no stickiness, no white cast - just fresh, hydrated skin. The texture is watery and really comfortable, so it works well even under makeup.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬用落去更似清爽嘅保濕霜多過防曬，我好鍾意。滲透超快，唔黏笠，唔泛白，就係清爽又保濕嘅皮膚。質地水潤，好舒服，搽底妝都好夾。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
